yes.snapshot: You are in a co‑working space downtown, laptop open, drafting a policy brief for a think‑tank. Mornings start with a quick jog along the harbour, evenings end with a glass of cider at a local pub. The master's degree you finished last semester gave you a research contract and a 15% salary bump.

no.snapshot: You are still behind the espresso machine at a chain café, the student loan balance blinking on your phone screen. Weekends are spent juggling gig‑work and a half‑finished dissertation draft you abandoned. The decision to postpone the master’s left you watching peers climb ladders you can’t see.
